reviewAccess.credentialsProvisioning: Supply dedicated review credentials through the relevant store review console only. Never commit them or place them in issue/PR text.
reviewNotesMustExplain: How to sign in with the dedicated review account.
How to browse catalogue/listing detail and create or edit a test listing.
How to open messaging, offers/orders and fulfilment flows.
Any sandbox/provider conditions that prevent real money movement during review.
Any account, verification or region eligibility that affects visible functionality.

submissionBlockers.detail: Privacy, terms, contact and retention policy content is still marked pending_legal_review and has no effective date.
Required English/Arabic Android/iOS screenshots have not yet been captured from real rendered UI.
Store records, categories, age/content questionnaires, pricing/distribution and review contacts must be completed in the real Apple/Google consoles.
Dedicated non-production reviewer credentials must be provisioned outside source control.
Candidate App Privacy/Data safety declarations must be reconciled against the final production SDK/provider inventory and approved privacy policy.

readyWhen: All required screenshots are captured and approved.
P0-31 legal/privacy content is approved and effective URLs are live.
Candidate privacy/data-safety manifests are reconciled against production providers and SDKs.
Internal/private testing completes without release-blocking defects.
Store-console records and reviewer access are configured by an authorised release operator.
